metadata.description: Supplier performance investigation focusing on supply chain issues and part availability

turns.content: Our procurement team reported that several key suppliers have delivery delays. Can you help me investigate supplier performance?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should propose analyzing supplier metrics

turns.content: What tables do we have related to suppliers and their parts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should return schema for SUPPLIER, PART, PARTSUPP tables

turns.content: Show me all suppliers and their total supply value.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show suppliers ranked by supply value

turns.content: For this analysis, always calculate supply value as PS_SUPPLYCOST * PS_AVAILQTY.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use this formula for supply value calculations

turns.content: Which suppliers have the highest number of parts supplied?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should count parts per supplier

turns.content: Let me focus on suppliers from GERMANY. Show me German suppliers and their performance.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter suppliers by nation = GERMANY

turns.content: What's the average availability quantity for German suppliers vs other nations?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare PS_AVAILQTY across nations

turns.content: German suppliers have lower availability. Let me check order fulfillment — show me lineitems from German suppliers and their delivery performance.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show delivery metrics (ship date vs receipt date)

turns.content: From now on, when analyzing delivery performance, calculate delay as L_RECEIPTDATE - L_SHIPDATE.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use this formula for delay calculations

turns.content: Show me the average delivery delay by supplier nation.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show average delay grouped by supplier nation

turns.content: German suppliers have the highest delays. Which specific German suppliers are the worst performers?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should rank German suppliers by delivery delay

turns.content: Let me check if these suppliers also have quality issues. Show me return flags for their lineitems.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show L_RETURNFLAG distribution for problematic suppliers

turns.content: What parts are most affected by delays from these suppliers?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show parts with longest delays from problematic suppliers

turns.content: Are these high-value parts? Show me the retail price of these delayed parts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join PART table and show P_RETAILPRICE

turns.content: These are expensive parts. Let me see the revenue impact — show me orders affected by these delays.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show order-level impact of delays

turns.content: Remember the delivery delay calculation we established? Apply it to show me orders that took more than 7 days.

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the delivery delay calculation we established
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use L_RECEIPTDATE - L_SHIPDATE and filter > 7

turns.content: What's the total revenue value of orders affected by long delays?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should sum order totals for delayed orders

turns.content: That's significant. Let me check if this correlates with customer complaints — show me order priorities for delayed orders.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show O_ORDERPRIORITY distribution for delayed orders

turns.content: High-priority orders are being delayed. Let me check if certain ship modes are worse.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze L_SHIPMODE for delayed orders

turns.content: Now I want to exclude RAIL ship mode from our analysis — we're investigating that separately.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out L_SHIPMODE = 'RAIL'

turns.content: With RAIL excluded, show me the remaining delay distribution by supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should re-run delay analysis excluding RAIL

turns.content: Which customers are most affected by these supplier delays?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show customers with most delayed orders

turns.content: Are these customers from specific regions?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join CUSTOMER and NATION to show regional distribution

turns.content: European customers are most affected. Earlier we looked at German suppliers — which specific German suppliers serve European customers?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show German suppliers serving European customers

turns.content: Let me see the trend over time. Show me monthly delivery delays for these suppliers.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show delay trends by month

turns.content: Delays increased in Q3. Is this across all part types?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze delays by P_TYPE

turns.content: Certain part types have worse delays. Do we have alternative suppliers for these parts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should check PARTSUPP for other suppliers of same parts

turns.content: Show me the supply cost difference between problematic suppliers and alternatives.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare PS_SUPPLYCOST across suppliers for same parts

turns.content: The alternative suppliers are more expensive but faster. Let me calculate the tradeoff. What would be the cost increase if we switched?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate cost difference for switching suppliers

turns.content: Use the supply value formula we established earlier to calculate this.

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the supply value formula we established earlier
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use PS_SUPPLYCOST * PS_AVAILQTY

turns.content: What's the total potential savings in delivery time if we switch?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate time saved by switching

turns.content: Let me see a summary of affected orders with all filters applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show affected orders excluding RAIL, using correct formulas

turns.content: Can you create a chart showing delay by supplier nation?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should generate appropriate visualization

turns.content: What filters are currently applied to our analysis?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: delivery delay formula, supply value formula, exclude RAIL

turns.content: Good. Now show me the top 10 parts by total delay hours, with all filters applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should rank parts by delay with all established filters

turns.content: Let me compare this to the overall supplier performance. Show me all suppliers ranked by on-time delivery rate.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate on-time percentage per supplier

turns.content: What's the correlation between supply cost and on-time delivery rate?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze relationship between PS_SUPPLYCOST and delay rate

turns.content: Show me the worst performing suppliers with their full details including contact information.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show supplier details with performance metrics

turns.content: Can you create a summary report of supplier performance issues?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide summary visualization

turns.content: Thank you. We've identified that German suppliers have the worst delivery delays, especially for high-value parts going to European customers. The alternative suppliers would cost more but significantly improve delivery times.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings summary

persistedCorrections.description: Use this formula for all supply value calculations
Use this formula for all delivery delay calculations

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Exclude RAIL ship mode from analysis
persistedCorrections.description: Filter out L_SHIPMODE = 'RAIL' in all subsequent queries

anaphoricReferences.phrase: the delivery delay calculation we established
the supply value formula we established earlier
